title: feat(plugin-chatbot,i18n): the copilot's change card draws the draft posture, and the applied card offers review and undo (objectui#12894)
body:
Part of #12894
Part of #12725
Clause-②: yes

**The copilot's change card and applied card draw the draft posture objectstack-ai/cloud now sends** (ruling A on cloud#2924; cloud PR #2974 as `f9e45145`, and cloud PR #3004 as `1e3e04f8` for `apply_blueprint`'s extend mode). This is also objectui#12725's Target item 4 (change card v2), as the StudioRailCopilot artboard draws it, without the composer half (see "Not drawn"). objectui#12725 stays open for its other items.

## Premise, re-read on `main` (`03f1d652`)

- `changesConfirmLabel` was a host prop of `ChatbotEnhanced` (default `'Confirm'`); nothing on the envelope could change it.
- `detectProposedChanges` kept `summary` and the rows. `detectReplayOutcome` kept `kind`, `packageId` and the publish failure. `posture`, `primaryAction`, `draftState`, `existingRows` and `appliedCard` were dropped before render.
- The drafted outcome drew a badge and a Publish button only.

The premise holds.

## The producer (read at cloud `1e3e04f8`, `packages/service-ai-studio`)

- `changesProposedEnvelope` (`metadata-tools.ts`) adds `posture` (from `postureEnvelope`: `mode`, `liveRecords`, optional `platformPackage` and `buildTurnRows`) and `primaryAction` (`save_draft` or `confirm`). It adds both only when the environment publishes AI changes in the turn. `summary` carries `confirmChangeAsDraft` in the user's language. The rows come from `describeEditOps` / `describeChange` (`confirm-gate.ts`); a row's `details` is `changeParams` (label, default, required).
- `describeLandedChange` stamps `draftState` (`readDraftState` in `change-posture.ts`: `pending`, `items`, `others`) on the applied envelope. On a change saved as a draft it also stamps `existingRows` and `appliedCard` (`savedAsDraft`, `existingRowsEmpty`, `checkedStructure`).
- No schema declares these envelopes (cloud's `build-cards.schema.json` covers the build cards only). So the producer's source is the declaration. The fixtures copy it, and the producer's own test edit (`RENEWAL_EDIT` in `copilot-change-posture.test.ts`).

## What changed

**Mappers** (`mapMessages.ts`):
- `detectProposedChanges` keeps `posture` and `primaryAction`, and nothing else new. A posture without both `mode` and `liveRecords`, or an action outside `save_draft` / `confirm`, is dropped whole.
- `detectReplayOutcome` keeps `draftState`, `existingRows` and `appliedCard`, on a `drafted` replay only. A draft state without both counts, a card without a title, and malformed rows are dropped.
- Every absent key leaves exactly the shape an older cloud produced.
- The app-shell's hydration path calls the same two detectors, so a reloaded conversation lifts the new keys too.

**Change card** (`ChangePlanBody` in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`), drawn when the envelope carries `posture` or `primaryAction`:
- the header 「修改方案 · N 项」 / "Change plan · N changes";
- one row per change: a ＋ / ✎ / － symbol, the kind (字段 / 视图 / 对象 …), `object · field`, and the type and `details` in mono small type;
- the `summary` as an amber note when `posture.mode` is `draft`, else as plain text;
- the primary button reads 存为草稿 / "Save as draft" when `primaryAction` is `save_draft`, and the host's `changesConfirmLabel` otherwise. 调整 is unchanged.

**Applied card** (`AppliedDraftCard`), drawn on a drafted replay that carries `appliedCard`:
- `appliedCard.title` beside a tick, and its `lines`;
- 查看变更并发布 / "Review changes and publish" through a new host door, `onReviewDrafts(packageId)`;
- 撤销 / "Undo" through a new host door, `onDiscardDrafts(packageId)`.

`discard-drafts` drops EVERY pending draft of the package (framework runtime `domains/packages.ts`, protocol `discardPackageDrafts`, read at the pin `be076dad28a0`). So when `draftState.others` is non-zero, 撤销 says so (「撤销（连同另外 2 项草稿）」), and a confirm names the counts before anything runs (「撤销会丢弃这个应用包全部 3 项未发布的草稿，其中 2 项不属于这次修改。」, then 全部撤销 / 取消).

**i18n:** new `chatbot.changes.*` keys in all ten packs: the title, the actions and the confirm (count families with every CLDR category each language selects), and the row kinds.

## Measured: neither door reaches the console without `packages/app-shell`

This is the dispatch's stop rule, and it turned out to apply to both buttons, not only to 查看变更并发布.

- **撤销.** The chat has no fetch of its own. The publish call the dispatch asked to mirror is the host door `onPublishDrafts`, which `ChatPane` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`) wires through `metadataClient.publishPackageDrafts`. So 撤销 is a host door here too, `onDiscardDrafts`. The console half is `ChatPane` passing it. `MetadataClient` has no `discardPackageDrafts` today; `PackagesPage`'s `discardDrafts` posts to `discard-drafts` with a bare fetch.
- **查看变更并发布.** The 在 Studio 中查看 navigation (`onDesignBuiltApp` in `ChatPane`) goes to Studio's Interfaces pillar. Studio's 变更 drawer is `changesOpen`, component state in `StudioDesignSurface`, with no URL parameter or bus that opens it. So the door is `onReviewDrafts(packageId)`. The console half is `ChatPane` passing it, plus a way into `StudioDesignSurface`'s `changesOpen`.
- **Until a host wires them,** the applied card draws its title and lines and keeps the inline Publish button (`onPublishDrafts`) where 查看变更并发布 would be. It draws no 撤销. Both doors are drawn and tested here behind their props. The console wiring waits for objectui#12725's phase 5, which holds `app-shell`.

## Decisions for review

- **The v2 gate.** The card draws v2 only when `posture` or `primaryAction` is present; the producer sends the two together. An envelope without them (an older cloud, or an environment that does not publish AI changes in the turn) draws the old card, with the host's title and verb labels.
- **The removal symbol.** The artboard draws ＋ and ✎. A removal row (`delete_field`) draws － in red rather than ✎.
- **When 撤销 asks first.** 撤销 runs at once only when it can show that this change's drafts are the only ones pending. It asks first when `draftState.others` is above 0, or when there is no `draftState`. It also asks when the host's live `fetchPendingDraftCount` reads more drafts than this change staged: a later change in the same conversation stages more drafts into the same package, and the snapshot on an older card cannot know that. The console already wires `fetchPendingDraftCount`.
- **The message 存为草稿 sends.** It is unchanged: the button sends `changesConfirmMessage`. 「存为草稿」 alone does not match cloud's `PROPOSAL_APPROVAL_RE`, so changing the message would leave the button inert.
- **Row kinds.** A metadata type the pack has no word for renders as its machine name; a verb no kind covers renders as its verb label.

## Not drawn

- the composer's 「借阅看板 ×」 chip and its placeholder: objectui#12725 phase 5, in `app-shell`;
- 补默认值: objectui#12929. The mapper keeps `existingRows` for it;
- the 变更 badge: objectui#12725 phase 5;
- the artboard's 「等待确认」 and 「未发布」 chips. No key declares them, and the title already says 「· N 项未发布」.

## Tests

At `a1601be5` (after merging `main` at `0707b4ae`), every run through the shared verify lock:
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-chatbot/`: 68 files passed (68), 711 tests passed (711). `git ls-files` counts 68 tracked test files in the package.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/`: 83 files passed (83), 1325 passed and 13 skipped (1338). 83 tracked test files.
- New: `mapMessages.changePosture-12894.test.ts` covers each kept key, each absent key degrading, malformed values dropped whole, no other envelope key lifted, and the live mapper carrying both lifts. `ChatbotEnhanced.changeCardV2-12894.test.tsx` covers 存为草稿 on `save_draft` and the host label on `confirm`; the rows' symbol, kind, target and small type; the amber note; the old card for an older cloud; the applied card's title, lines and both doors; 撤销 at once with nothing else pending; 撤销 asking with the counts when `others` is above 0, or the live count is higher, or there is no draft state; cancel; a refused discard; and the Publish fallback without a review door. Both run through the real mapper from raw tool parts, on the fixtures in `fixtures/changePosture.fixtures.ts`.

**Ablation (one, on a mapper):** through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `primaryAction` was dropped from `detectProposedChanges`'s return (anchor 1 to 0, blob `1b39ebbf` to `bd565dbe`). The two new suites went red: 6 failed and 26 passed of 32. Those were four mapper cases and the zh and en render cases, where the button read 确认修改 / Confirm. Restore: blob back to `1b39ebbf`, equal to `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` empty. The suites import `mapMessages` and `ChatbotEnhanced` relatively, so no dist was involved.

## Gates (local, at `a1601be5`)

- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0 each. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists 68 test files in the chatbot program, the two new ones among them, plus the fixture.
- `lint` for both packages: exit 0, 0 errors. None of the 120 warnings falls on an added line.
- Exit 0 each: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (0 en values changed, 25 keys added), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:lint-rule-coverage`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-types`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:action-ref-convention`, and the scripts `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check-type-check-coverage` and `check-lint-coverage`.
- NOT MEASURED here, so CI's runs are the evidence: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s type-check and suite. It is the one consumer of the widened types, and its dependency closure (19 unbuilt packages) was not built in this shared container. The widening only adds optional members. `check:readme-exports` and `check:eager-locale-catalogues` need dists this run did not build; this diff touches no README.

## Screenshots

On the evidence branch `claude/issue-12894-evidence` (`25b88b08`, never merged; no image is in this diff), rendered at 1280 px, light, through the real mapper and `ChatbotEnhanced` in a 360 px right slot:

- the applied card: [zh](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/25b88b08d96ef42ac34ffb4499aaef18c1202664/docs/design/findings/12894/zh-applied-card.png?raw=true) · [en](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/25b88b08d96ef42ac34ffb4499aaef18c1202664/docs/design/findings/12894/en-applied-card.png?raw=true) · [zh at 1280](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/25b88b08d96ef42ac34ffb4499aaef18c1202664/docs/design/findings/12894/zh-applied-card-1280.png?raw=true) · [en at 1280](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/25b88b08d96ef42ac34ffb4499aaef18c1202664/docs/design/findings/12894/en-applied-card-1280.png?raw=true)
- 撤销 with one other draft pending, asking first: [zh](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/25b88b08d96ef42ac34ffb4499aaef18c1202664/docs/design/findings/12894/zh-applied-card-undo-confirm.png?raw=true) · [en](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/25b88b08d96ef42ac34ffb4499aaef18c1202664/docs/design/findings/12894/en-applied-card-undo-confirm.png?raw=true)

The branch's `docs/design/findings/12894/README.md` says how they were rendered and what is faked: the envelopes, and the three host doors as no-ops.

## Acceptance notes

- A conversation restored from the console's local display cache draws the drafted badge, not the applied card. The cache copy in `useChatConversation` (`replayOutcomeToCachedResult`) keeps only the minimal replay envelope. Widening it is an `app-shell` change outside this claim. Carrier: none; noted, not filed.
- 撤销's done state lives in the component, like the confirm card's other client-side states. After a reload, an undone card offers 撤销 again, and a second run discards whatever is pending then. The live-count check asks first when more drafts are pending than this change staged. A count does not name items, so it cannot tell one unrelated draft from this change's own, and that one case runs without asking. Carrier: none; noted, not filed.

## Published faces

- `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`:
  - `ProposedChanges` gains optional `posture` and `primaryAction`;
  - `ReplayOutcome` gains optional `draftState`, `existingRows` and `appliedCard`;
  - `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`'s `proposedChanges` and `replayOutcome` now reference those two types instead of repeating them inline, so they widen the same way;
  - `ChatbotEnhancedProps` gains optional `onReviewDrafts` and `onDiscardDrafts`.
  - The new member types (`ChangePosture`, `ChangeDraftState`, `PendingDraftItem`, `ExistingRowsLine`, `AppliedCard` in `mapMessages.ts`) are not re-exported from the package entry.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: new `chatbot.changes.*` keys in every pack.

The claim declares `Clause-②: yes` for this, and the seat's contract review is on this PR.
